tasks.title: Version 0.1 dev 1
tasks.description:
The first release of A very ordinary farming game(AVOFG).
-30 Crops(Crops Boards)
-5 Level of Tools(Tools Board)
-Woodcutting(Woodcutting Board) and Mining(Mining)
-Fishing(Fishing Board) and Cooking(Cooking Board)
-5 Dungeons
-50 enemies
-20 mutations
-100 types of gear
-A village and overworld to explore
-50 Towers,with 10 upgardes each
